Requests above 100 MW are scaled proportionally. Green supply follows requests with inertia; batteries absorb mismatches. Emptying any battery ends the attempt. Gold is current load; cyan shows the locally forecast load in 1.5 seconds. Click each rail to set requested power. Inspect and adjust before launch. Live power corrections remain available until a battery empties. CERTIFY NOW commits the current transition. The first empty battery or rejected certification ends the episode.
